packageRules.description: One PR per Actual release: the api and the test server move together, or the api runs ahead of the server and ADR-007 aborts (AGENTS.md, "Versions: follow Actual"). It is a feat(deps), so a release, whose notes say which server it needs (CONTRIBUTING.md).
Node follows Actual's own .nvmrc, not Node's latest. Renovate cannot read another project's .nvmrc, so the node-follows-actual CI check says what to set instead.
